name: YS LeadGen – Popup Builder, Contact Form Builder, Exit Intent, Optin Forms & Lead Generation
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Capture more leads, grow your email list, and recover abandoning shoppers with an all-in-one WordPress popup plugin and contact form builder.

Every day, potential buyers visit your website, browse a page or two, and leave before subscribing, requesting a quote, or completing their checkout. Turning that traffic into revenue requires showing the right offer at the exact moment a visitor is ready to act.

YS LeadGen combines a drag-and-drop popup builder, a conditional contact form builder, an interactive spin-to-win coupon wheel maker, and a WooCommerce lead generation suite inside one fast, native WordPress popup plugin.

Design high-converting exit intent popups, email optin forms, sticky floating bars, multi-step forms, conversational forms, payment forms, and WooCommerce cart recovery popups directly inside your WordPress dashboard—with full data ownership and zero pageview limits.

Try the Live Demo | Official Website | Documentation | Pricing & Plans

⚡ How YS LeadGen Works in 4 Steps

  1. Choose a Popup or Form Template: Start from a conversion-ready template for exit intent popups, email optin forms, contact forms, or spin wheels—or build from a blank canvas.
  2. Customize in the Drag & Drop Builder: Edit layouts, typography, colors, animations, and custom form fields with instant visual previews.
  3. Set Smart Triggers & Targeting Rules: Trigger your campaign on desktop or mobile exit intent, scroll depth, time delay, click events, geo-location, or WooCommerce cart conditions.
  4. Publish, Sync Leads & Track Revenue: Launch your campaign in one click, sync leads to your CRM, run A/B split tests, and track conversions and WooCommerce sales in real time.

🌟 Core Capabilities of YS LeadGen Popup Builder & Form Builder

  • Visual Drag & Drop Popup Maker & Form Builder: Build modal popups, sticky bars, slide-ins, and embedded page forms on one unified visual canvas with smooth cross-fade submission transitions.
  • Desktop & Mobile Exit Intent Popups: Detect upward cursor movement toward the browser bar on desktop and rapid scroll-up or back-button gestures on mobile phones.
  • Complete Contact Form Builder & Payment Forms: Create contact forms, multi-step forms, Typeform-style conversational forms, conditional logic forms, file upload forms, and payment forms with Stripe, PayPal, and Square.
  • Gamified Spin-to-Win Coupon Wheels & Quizzes: Boost email optin rates with interactive prize wheels, Yes/No two-step optin forms, lead segmentation quizzes, and countdown timers.
  • WooCommerce Cart Abandonment & Upsell Popups: Stop cart and checkout abandonment, auto-generate dynamic WooCommerce discount coupons, send cart recovery emails, and trigger product upsell popups.
  • Granular Visitor, Geo & Paragraph Targeting: Target visitors by page, post, in-article paragraph number, device, browser, OS, country/state, referral URL, or UTM parameter.
  • A/B Split Testing, Revenue Analytics & AI Insights: Compare popup and form variations head-to-head, measure attributed WooCommerce revenue, push events to Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and get AI optimization tips.
  • Local Lead Storage & Direct CRM Integrations: Store every submission in your WordPress database, export to CSV, or auto-sync with Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Brevo, HubSpot, Omnisend, ActiveCampaign, GetResponse, Drip, Kit, Zapier, and Make.
  • Lightweight Frontend Performance: Assets load conditionally only on pages where an active popup or form campaign is running, protecting your Core Web Vitals.

🎯 17+ Popup Builder & Optin Form Campaign Types

Build every type of lead generation and conversion campaign using one WordPress popup plugin:

1. Modal Popups, Exit Intent Popups & Floating Bars

  • Lightbox Popups: Classic centered modal popups that focus visitor attention on your newsletter optin form, lead magnet, or special offer.
  • Exit Intent Popups: Present a targeted discount or lead magnet the exact moment a visitor moves to close their tab or leave checkout.
  • Sticky Floating Bars: Pin a persistent top header bar or bottom footer bar for storewide announcements, free shipping bars, and flash sales.
  • Slide-In Scroll Boxes: Smoothly slide a polite optin form or related offer into the corner of the screen as readers scroll down an article.
  • Fullscreen Welcome Mats: Greet arriving visitors with a full-screen lead capture campaign before they scroll into the main page content.
  • Floating Action Badges: Place a compact corner launcher icon that opens a popup form, contact form, or promo widget on click.

2. Gamified Spin Wheels, Interactive Quizzes & Compliance Popups

  • Spin-to-Win Coupon Wheels: Turn email lead generation into an interactive game where visitors spin a wheel to win an instant WooCommerce coupon code.
  • Yes/No Two-Step Optin Popups: Increase engagement by asking a simple Yes/No micro-commitment question before displaying the email optin form.
  • Interactive Quiz Popups: Ask multi-choice questions to qualify leads, segment subscribers, and recommend the right product or service.
  • Countdown Timer Popups: Create urgency for seasonal sales and limited-time offers with a live countdown clock.
  • Content Locker Popups: Require visitors to submit their email address to unlock gated blog content, guides, or downloads.
  • Social Proof Notification Popups: Show subtle corner popups highlighting recent signups or purchases to build immediate shopper confidence.
  • Video Lightbox Popups: Embed YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted explainer and product videos inside a clean modal popup player.
  • Age Verification & GDPR Cookie Consent Popups: Restrict age-sensitive pages behind an age gate or display a cookie consent banner that blocks tracking scripts until accepted.

3. Contact Form Builder, Conversational Forms & Payment Forms

  • Embedded & Auto-Inserted Post Forms: Place optin forms and contact forms anywhere via shortcode or blocks, or auto-insert them after specific paragraphs inside blog posts.
  • Multi-Step Forms & Conversational Forms: Break long forms into guided steps or use an interactive conversational form layout that presents one question at a time.
  • Conditional Logic & File Upload Forms: Build smart contact forms, quote calculators, client intake forms, and surveys with conditional show/hide rules and file uploads.
  • Stripe, PayPal & Square Payment Forms: Accept one-time payments, project deposits, donations, and product orders directly inside your forms with sandbox test mode.

🧠 Precision Popup Triggers & Visitor Targeting Rules

Combine behavioral triggers and display rules using flexible AND/OR logic so every visitor sees relevant campaigns:

  • Smart Behavioral Triggers: Trigger popups on desktop/mobile exit intent, time on page, scroll depth percentage, CSS click selectors, on-site retargeting, or scheduled date ranges.
  • Page, Category & Paragraph Insertion Rules: Show or exclude campaigns on specific pages, posts, custom post types, URL paths, or after a chosen paragraph number inside posts.
  • Geo-Location Targeting (Country & State): Display region-specific promotions, shipping notices, or localized optin forms based on visitor country or state.
  • Device, Browser, OS & Language Rules: Serve dedicated layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, or filter by browser, operating system, and browser language.
  • Traffic Source & UTM Parameter Targeting: Match popup offers to specific ad campaigns, referral domains, or URL query parameters.
  • Visitor Frequency & Conversion Controls: Control how often returning visitors see a popup and automatically hide campaigns from users who have already converted.

🛒 WooCommerce Popups: Cart Abandonment Recovery & Upsells

Turn browsing shoppers into repeat buyers with built-in e-commerce rules for WooCommerce:

  • Cart & Checkout Abandonment Popups: Trigger an exit intent popup on the WooCommerce cart or checkout page offering an instant discount or free shipping to save the sale.
  • Automated Cart Recovery Emails: Send scheduled follow-up emails to shoppers who leave items behind in their cart.
  • Dynamic WooCommerce Coupon Generator: Automatically create and display a unique WooCommerce coupon code when a customer submits your optin form.
  • Product Upsell & Cross-Sell Popups: Recommend complementary items or higher-value bundles when specific products are added to the cart.
  • Cart Value, Item & Coupon Page Rules: Trigger WooCommerce popups based on minimum/maximum cart subtotal, item count, specific products in cart, or coupon page visits.

📊 Popup Analytics, A/B Split Testing, GA4 & CRM Integrations

  • Conversion & WooCommerce Revenue Analytics: Monitor views, form submissions, conversion rates, and exact WooCommerce store revenue generated by every popup and form campaign.
  • A/B Split Testing: Test different headlines, designs, offers, and triggers side by side to identify your highest-converting variation.
  • Built-In AI Optimization Insights: Analyze campaign performance automatically and receive actionable recommendations to lift conversion rates.
  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Event Sync: Push popup impressions and form conversion events directly to Google Analytics 4.
  • Centralized Lead Hub & JSON Portability: View, search, filter, and export leads to CSV in one click, or export and import full campaign setups as JSON files.
  • Works With All Page Builders & Form Plugins: Compatible with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Bricks, Beaver Builder, and Oxygen. You can also wrap existing Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, or Fluent Forms inside YS LeadGen popups.
  • Built-In SMTP & Google reCAPTCHA: Configure custom SMTP email delivery inside the plugin and protect your contact forms and optin forms from bots with Google reCAPTCHA.

External Services

YS LeadGen does not contact any outside service until you turn on a feature or integration that needs one:

  • Email marketing services: Used only if you connect one in Integrations. When a visitor submits a campaign linked to a connected service, their submitted details (such as name and email address) are sent to that service: Mailchimp, Brevo, Klaviyo, GetResponse, Drip, ActiveCampaign, Kit, Omnisend, and HubSpot. Each service’s own terms and privacy policy apply.
  • Stripe, PayPal, and Square: Used only if you add a payment field to a form. The payment amount and details needed to process the transaction are sent to the provider when a visitor submits the form. Stripe | PayPal | Square
  • Webhooks (Zapier, Make, or another URL): Used only if you add a webhook to a campaign. Lead data is sent to the URL you provide each time the campaign captures a lead. Zapier | Make
  • Google Analytics 4: Used only if you enable GA4 tracking. Campaign events, such as views and conversions, are sent to your Google Analytics property. Privacy policy
  • Google reCAPTCHA: Used only on forms where you turn reCAPTCHA on. When such a form loads or is submitted, the visitor’s IP address and browser interaction data are sent to Google. Terms | Privacy policy
  • YouTube and Vimeo: Used only if you add a video popup embedding a video from one of these services. The visitor’s browser loads the player directly from the provider, which may receive the visitor’s IP address. YouTube | Vimeo

Privacy

YS LeadGen runs on your own WordPress site and does not collect personal information on its own, only through the forms and popups you build. If you connect a third-party service, such as an email marketing tool, the information a visitor submits is sent to that service once the connection is turned on. You stay responsible for your site’s privacy policy and for meeting the privacy laws that apply to you.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard and go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for YS LeadGen, click Install Now, and click Activate.
  3. Open YS LeadGen from your WordPress admin menu and click Add New Campaign.
  4. Select a popup template or form template, customize it in the drag-and-drop builder, configure your triggers and targeting rules, and click Publish.
  5. Optional: Visit YS LeadGen > Integrations to connect your CRM or payment gateway, and YS LeadGen > Ecommerce Rules to enable WooCommerce cart recovery popups.
sections.faq:
What makes YS LeadGen a complete WordPress popup plugin and contact form builder?

YS LeadGen combines a drag-and-drop popup builder, an exit intent lead generation engine, a gamified spin-to-win wheel creator, and a full contact form builder (with multi-step, conversational, conditional logic, and payment forms) inside a single native WordPress plugin—with no monthly pageview limits.

Do I need coding skills to use the popup builder or form builder?

No. Every lightbox popup, exit intent popup, floating bar, spin wheel, optin form, and contact form is created using a visual drag-and-drop editor with ready-to-use templates and live previews.

How do exit intent popups work on desktop and mobile devices?

On desktop browsers, exit intent tracks mouse movement and velocity as the visitor’s cursor moves toward the browser tab or close button. On mobile devices, YS LeadGen detects rapid upward scroll gestures or back-button taps to display your popup before the visitor leaves your site.

Can I build contact forms, conversational forms, and payment forms?

Yes. YS LeadGen includes a full contact form builder supporting single-page forms, multi-step forms, Typeform-style conversational forms, conditional logic fields, file uploads, and payment collection via Stripe, PayPal, and Square. Any form can be displayed inside a popup or embedded directly on a page or blog post.

How does YS LeadGen help with WooCommerce cart abandonment and lead generation?

You can trigger exit intent popups on the WooCommerce cart and checkout pages, auto-generate unique discount coupons when shoppers submit an email optin form, send automated cart recovery emails, display product upsell popups, and target visitors by cart total or items in cart.

Where are my form submissions and email leads stored?

All leads and form submissions are saved directly inside your own WordPress database. You can search, filter, and export leads to CSV anytime, or automatically sync them with Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Brevo, HubSpot, Omnisend, ActiveCampaign, GetResponse, Drip, Kit, Zapier, or Make.

Will this WordPress popup plugin slow down my website?

No. YS LeadGen is built for fast page speed and Core Web Vitals. Frontend scripts and styles load conditionally only on pages where an active popup or form campaign is targeted to display.

Does YS LeadGen work with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and other form plugins?

Yes. YS LeadGen works seamlessly with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Bricks, Beaver Builder, and Oxygen. You can also embed and track forms from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, and Fluent Forms inside YS LeadGen popups.

When a visitor submits a campaign linked to a connected service, their submitted details (such as name and email address) are sent to that service: Mailchimp, Brevo, Klaviyo, GetResponse, Drip, ActiveCampaign, Kit, Omnisend, and HubSpot. Each service’s own terms and privacy policy apply.
  • Stripe, PayPal, and Square: Used only if you add a payment field to a form. The payment amount and details needed to process the transaction are sent to the provider when a visitor submits the form. Stripe | PayPal | Square
  • Webhooks (Zapier, Make, or another URL): Used only if you add a webhook to a campaign. Lead data is sent to the URL you provide each time the campaign captures a lead. Zapier | Make
  • Google Analytics 4: Used only if you enable GA4 tracking. Campaign events, such as views and conversions, are sent to your Google Analytics property. Privacy policy
  • Google reCAPTCHA: Used only on forms where you turn reCAPTCHA on. When such a form loads or is submitted, the visitor’s IP address and browser interaction data are sent to Google. Terms | Privacy policy
  • YouTube and Vimeo: Used only if you add a video popup embedding a video from one of these services. The visitor’s browser loads the player directly from the provider, which may receive the visitor’s IP address. YouTube | Vimeo

Privacy

YS LeadGen runs on your own WordPress site and does not collect personal information on its own, only through the forms and popups you build. If you connect a third-party service, such as an email marketing tool, the information a visitor submits is sent to that service once the connection is turned on. You stay responsible for your site’s privacy policy and for meeting the privacy laws that apply to you.
